name: PRESENTATION_V1
owner_decision: SPELL-PRESENT-0 §4, §7-§10 and §13 (docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_SPELL_PRESENT0_SPELL_AND_COMBAT_PRESENTATION_DECISION_2026-09-30.md, accepted by ACCEPT-SPELL-PRESENT0-V1); numbers leased to PRESENT-WIRE-1 by the #1622 control plane
owner: current ChannelRuntime (presentation derived from committed or refused owner decisions; the own actor's cooldowns)
offer_gate: PRESENT-WIRE-1 registers the codecs only: the server does not offer this capability before SPELL-PRESENT-1 or COMBAT-PRESENT-1 composes an emitter, and the B3 batch measurement of SPELL-PRESENT-0 §9 is recorded on #162 before activation. It requires 6 WORLD_SPATIAL_ENTITIES, whose D85 identities the events name. With it selected, domain 19 carries at most one batch of presentation events per sync unit (SPELLPRES0-RL-01..03; overflow keeps the observer's own events, then the nearest by D87, ties by decision and emission ordinal; a batch is dropped whole while SPELLPRES0-RL-07 batches are undelivered or a snapshot is in flight), domain 20 carries the own actor's cooldowns (a snapshot at admission, reconnect and channel transfer; a delta at each PRIMARY COMMIT that starts or changes one, and one corrective delta at the first liveness ack), and the command type 3 result may carry field 2 detail. Without it selected, domains 19 and 20 and field 2 are never sent and the session keeps today's behaviour; it is not refused.
